description:
\[Cheonma Gunlimbo\] is a "What if" story of Cheonmado, and is a work set after another ending. If you have enjoyed Cheonmado before, you will enjoy a different development, and even first-time readers will enjoy it as a new work. We ask for your interest and love!

I will open a new world. The distinction between the righteous faction, the evil faction, and the magical faction will no longer exist. The hundred greatest martial artists in the world! The ten greatest masters in the world! The most powerful in the world! Only that honor, dignity, and throne will rule the martial arts world!

(Source: Mukgeomhyang, translated)
